parts.text: Which choice fits both sizes he is measuring?

options.text: Millimetre for the pencil mark; metre for the classroom height.
Kilometre for the pencil mark; millimetre for the classroom height.
A 15-cm scale alone for the full classroom height.
Metre for the thin pencil mark; kilometre for the classroom height.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Farhan must measure the width of a thin pencil mark on paper and the height of his classroom ceiling.

part_answers.answer: A thin mark needs a small unit such as the millimetre; room height fits the metre, not kilometre or a short 15-cm scale alone.

teacher.key_rationale: Choose a unit and scale suited to size: millimetre for a thin mark, metre for classroom height. Kilometre and a short scale alone do not fit those sizes.
